mapper.select: SELECT s.code AS stock_code, s.name AS stock_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_buy_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sell_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.quantity ELSE -t.quantity END), 0) AS net_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sell_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.total_amount ELSE -t.total_amount END), 0) AS net_amount FROM transactions t JOIN stocks s ON s.id = t.stock_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY s.code, s.name ORDER BY s.code

SELECT FORMATDATETIME(t.transaction_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS trade_date, COUNT(*) AS trade_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.total_amount ELSE -t.total_amount END), 0) AS net_amount FROM transactions t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY FORMATDATETIME(t.transaction_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY trade_date DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.quantity * s.current_price), 0) FROM portfolios p JOIN stocks s ON s.id = p.stock_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.balance + COALESCE(hv.holding_value, 0) AS total_assets, CASE WHEN COALESCE(hc.holding_cost, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(hv.holding_value, 0) - hc.holding_cost) * 100.0 / hc.holding_cost, 2) END AS total_return_rate FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, SUM(p.quantity * s.current_price) AS holding_value FROM portfolios p JOIN stocks s ON s.id = p.stock_id GROUP BY p.user_id ) hv ON hv.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(quantity * average_price) AS holding_cost FROM portfolios GROUP BY user_id ) hc ON hc.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
